Real journal key is source owner + operation ID. Original stub keyed by intent hash missed collisions. Corrected the stub and reproduced journal_binding, then reused the stable shared source operation mapping and retained actorOperationId; both file/voice and private compatibility passed.
Voice authority import had an additional symbol so scripted edit missed the new helper; added the import, then the targeted lifecycle group and scoped types passed.
